task.description: Hard gate: validate the design artefact at src/design/AGT-01-04-agent-artifacts.md against requirements AGT-01, AGT-02, AGT-03, AGT-04. Verify: (1) every acceptance criterion from all four requirements is covered by the design, (2) no implementation code (no function bodies), (3) all error codes / HTTP status codes from the ACs are present, (4) migration DDL for agent_artifacts and task_specs tables is present, (5) type definitions are sufficient for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity. Return PASS only if all criteria are met; return FAIL with specific gaps if not.

result.summary: Design artefact fails lint gate (MAJOR=1 E050: fenced Zig block at line 273 exceeds 40 lines). MINOR inconsistency: data-flow step 5 uses <= instead of < for attempt_count regression guard. All AGT-01..04 acceptance criteria are substantively covered; only structural issues block PASS.

issues.description: Fenced Zig code block exceeds 40 lines. The API Response Shapes block (ArtifactCreatedResponse through TaskSpecExistsResponse) must be split into multiple shorter blocks, one per logical group, each with a prose heading.

Step [5] of the POST /api/v1/agent/artifacts data flow writes submitted attempt_count <= MAX(stored) but the Attempt Count Regression Guard section correctly specifies strictly-less-than (<). The <= form would reject a valid fresh insert at attempt_count == MAX. Fix: change <= to < in the data flow step.

result.next_action: Route back to CODE-DESIGNER for rework (rework_count will be 1).
